[SWS_UCM_00104] Consistency Check of processed Package
⌈
UCM
shall raise the ApplicationError ProcessedSoftwarePackageInconsistent
if integrity check of the processed Software Packages fails. This operation is real-
ized by the UCM to verify that it did not corrupt any files during the processing. This
integrity check may be realized by the UCM by checking the payload Checksum or by
any other mechanisms.
⌋

[SWS_UCM_00104] Consistency Check of processed Package
⌈

the ApplicationError ProcessedSoftwarePackageInconsistent if integrity
check of the processed Software Packages fails. This operation is realized by the
UCM to verify that it did not corrupt any files during the processing. This integrity check
may be realized by the UCM by checking the payload Checksum or by any other mech-
anisms.

[SWS_UCM_00104] Integrity Check of processed Package
⌈
UCM shall raise the ApplicationError kProcessedSoftwarePackageIncon-
sistent if integrity check of the processed Software Packages fails. The Processing State of a Software Package (processingState) shall transition to
kProcessingFailed.
